capabilities: Publish notes to Telegram channels, groups, forum topics and private chats
Format posts with Telegram standard and rich-text formatting, including LaTeX, tables, maps and media
Split a note into multiple posts with pre-written comments and buttons
Preview and configure each post (scheduling, silent sending, link preview, editing published posts)
Connect through MTProto, SOCKS5 or HTTP(S) proxies
disambiguation: Unrelated to Obsidian's core Publish feature; it sends notes to Telegram rather than publishing a website.
extras: The README discloses that network calls go only to t.me; proxies work only in the desktop app (mobile connects directly); a detailed user guide is available inside the plugin settings; installation via BRAT is supported for beta versions.
motivation: The author, a Religious Studies scholar, says the plugin helps him in his research and in teaching a university course on IT in scientific research.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to send notes as Telegram messages with Telegram's formatting, attachments and scheduling options.
summary: Publishing plugin that posts Obsidian notes to Telegram channels, groups, forum topics and personal chats as a user account or a bot.
